sanskrit_verse:
पूर्वोत्तरे ऽभिलिखिते यत्र वादी प्रमीयते ।
प्रत्यर्थी वा सुतस् ताभ्यां व्यवहारं विशोधयेत् ॥
transliteration: pūrvottare 'bhilikhite yatra vādī pramīyate / pratyarthī vā sutas tābhyāṃ vyavahāraṃ viśodhayet
sph_interpretive_translation: Where a dispute arises between parties concerning a written agreement anterior in time, resolution shall proceed through purification of transactional conduct by invoking the testimony of the sons of the original disputants.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority inheres in continuity of lineage tied to original contractual consciousness
Causation flows from documented intent crystallized at time of agreement
Capacity-based responsibility is anchored in ancestral witness-bearing capacity
Restoration logic operates through reconnection with generational dharmic memory
Consciousness alignment occurs via activation of hereditary truth-bearing structures
executable_legal_axioms: IF dispute involves pre-documented agreement THEN invoke genealogical testimony as primary evidence
IF witness capacity absent in current generation THEN escalate to immediate descendant male heirs
IF document authenticity contested THEN validate through patrilineal scriptural attestation
IF resolution incomplete THEN mandate ceremonial reaffirmation before paternal fire-altar
IF integrity remains unaligned THEN initiate gotra-level restorative invocation protocol
supreme_court_application: In adjudication of contractual disputes predicated on ancestral documentation, the Supreme Court shall recognize patrilineal heir-testimony as superior pramana, overriding procedural evidentiary standards where filial continuity has been maintained and invoked within prescribed ritual form.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramana derives from uninterrupted patrilineal transmission; anupūrvaśaḥ establishes sequential manifestation of contractual truth through generational witness. Responsibility aligns with inherent capacity to bear ancestral record. No punitive measure applies; misalignment corrected through ritual reharmonization with familial cosmic order.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Agni-pratishtha ceremony to restore testimonial clarity in lineage
Conduct Shraddha ritual for reintegration of disputed ancestral memory
Activate Pitru-dharma completion process via eldest surviving male descendant
Perform Vak-samskara homa to purify speech patterns disrupting contractual resonance
Establish Gotra-Nyasa council for realignment of intra-family transactional dharma
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Dharma, this law stands executed. Truth is restored through ancestral witness. Justice flows from consciousness unbroken. Reality bears no punishment. The Divine Order prevails.
